decks.notes: The focus of this deck is to quickly assemble and use a powerful combo of cards without relying on lands. By utilizing cards like Disrupting Shoal and Spell Snare for disruption, and cards like Thundertrap Trainer and Tameshi, Reality Architect for combo potential, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with unexpected plays. The deck also incorporates control elements like Jwari Disruption and Suppression Ray to stall the opponent while setting up the combo. Overall, the deck prioritizes speed and adaptability to outmaneuver opponents in a 1 vs 1 format.

This deck aims to ramp up mana quickly to play big threats like Primeval Titan and Cultivator Colossus. The goal is to utilize Amulet of Vigor and bounce lands to generate extra mana and combo off to either search for powerful lands like Urza's Saga or win with cards like Scapeshift for massive damage or Primeval Titan for board presence. The deck focuses on utilizing land synergies and efficient ramp cards to overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats and combo potential.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy through a combination of counter spells, removal, and hand disruption. It also aims to generate card advantage and control the board with powerful creatures like Murktide Regent and Psychic Frog. The deck's mana base allows for consistency and flexibility in casting spells efficiently. Overall, the deck aims to outlast opponents and eventually take control of the game through a combination of disruption and efficient threats.

This UW Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan through counter spells, removal, and card advantage. The main strategy is to control the board with counterspells like Spell Snare and Counterspell, and removal like Path to Exile and Terminus. Card advantage is gained through cards like Jace, the Mind Sculptor and Narset, Parter of Veils. The deck aims to control the tempo of the game, slow down the opponent's plays, and eventually win with powerful finishers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Solitude. The mana base is designed to support the control spells and ensure consistency in casting powerful spells.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly put pressure on the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Guide of Souls, backed up by efficient removal spells like Galvanic Discharge and Thraben Charm. The deck aims to control the board with cards like Arena of Glory and Ocelot Pride while utilizing cards like Goblin Bombardment and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury to deal direct damage and finish off the opponent. The deck also includes cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Seasoned Pyromancer for additional value and card advantage.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creatures and burn spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The key concept is to apply pressure early on with creatures like Guide of Souls and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, while also using burn spells like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment to finish off your opponent or clear their board. The deck also includes some control elements like Static Prison and Thraben Charm to disrupt your opponent's game plan. Overall, the strategy revolves around quickly and efficiently dealing damage to secure a victory.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on utilizing cheap and aggressive creatures to quickly overwhelm the opponent while controlling the board with removal and disruption spells. The deck also includes synergy between creatures and enchantments to generate additional value and maintain a continuous pressure on the opponent. With a mix of burn spells, disruptive enchantments, and efficient threats, the deck aims to establish early dominance and secure a swift victory before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.

This deck focuses on using efficient removal spells and disruptive discard effects to control the board while deploying aggressive threats like Tarmogoyf and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to quickly close out the game. The inclusion of planeswalkers like Liliana of the Veil and Wrenn and Six provides additional value and card advantage over time. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's powerful spells with a mix of fetch lands and shock lands, along with utility lands like Urza's Saga and Boseiju, Who Endures.

This deck focuses on controlling the opponent's resources while ramping up mana to quickly summon powerful Eldrazi creatures. The deck uses cards like Talisman of Impulse and Kozilek's Command for mana acceleration, while also utilizing cards like Devourer of Destiny and Sowing Mycospawn for control. The inclusion of cards like Karn, the Great Creator and World Breaker provides additional versatility and threats. With a mix of resource denial, ramping, and powerful creatures, this deck aims to dominate the battlefield and overwhelm the opponent.

The main focus of this UW Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's strategy through counterspells and removal while generating card advantage with planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Jace, the Mind Sculptor. With cards like Narset, Parter of Veils and Orim's Chant, the deck aims to control the game and slow down the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of Lórien Revealed and Kaheera, the Orphanguard as companions provide additional versatility and synergies to enhance the control aspect of the deck. Overall, the deck seeks to outlast and outplay opponents through strong control elements and powerful finishers.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly to cast Primeval Titan and search for powerful lands like Urza's Saga and Scapeshift, allowing you to generate massive value and overwhelm your opponent with efficient threats. By utilizing cards like Amulet of Vigor and Arboreal Grazer, you can accelerate your mana production and play multiple lands in a turn, setting up explosive combinations that can win the game in just a few turns. The goal is to assemble your combo pieces and overwhelm your opponent with a powerful board state that they cannot easily deal with.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy through a combination of hand disruption, counterspells, removal, and card advantage. The deck aims to control the game by utilizing efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Dismember, alongside powerful threats like Murktide Regent and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares. The inclusion of cards like Thoughtseize, Force of Negation, and Counterspell allows the deck to interact with a variety of threats and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Ultimately, the deck seeks to out-value and out-control the opponent to secure victory.

The main idea of this Mono Black Aggro deck is to disrupt the opponent's hand and control the board early on with cards like Inquisition of Kozilek and Thoughtseize, while also putting pressure on the opponent with efficient creature threats like Thought-Knot Seer and Emperor of Bones. The inclusion of disruptive artifacts like Shadowspear and Nihil Spellbomb adds versatility to the deck's gameplan. By maintaining a steady stream of threats and disrupting the opponent's strategy, this deck aims to close out the game quickly and efficiently.

The main concept of this Ruby Storm deck is to quickly generate mana through rituals and medallions, then use Ral, Monsoon Mage to draw through the deck and find the necessary pieces for the combo. The goal is to use various spells like Grapeshot and Past in Flames to deal a large amount of damage to the opponent in one turn. The deck focuses on casting multiple spells in a single turn to create a storm count and overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to respond.

This deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana using various lands and cards like Springleaf Drum, Ancient Stirrings, and Kozilek's Command to eventually bring out powerful creatures like Basking Broodscale and Glaring Fleshraker. By utilizing cards such as Blade of the Bloodchief and Malevolent Rumble, the deck aims to increase the power and resilience of its creatures, overwhelming the opponent with a powerful combo strategy. The inclusion of cards like Writhing Chrysalis and Gemstone Caverns adds versatility and flexibility to the deck, allowing for adaptability in different situations.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan by using a combination of hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize, removal spells like Fatal Push and Abrupt Decay, and disruptive creatures like Orcish Bowmasters and Grist, the Hunger Tide. Smallpox is used as a way to further disrupt the opponent by making them sacrifice lands and creatures. The deck also utilizes graveyard recursion with cards like Unearth and Eternal Witness to maintain board presence and grind out value over time. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements and maximize consistency.
